benchmark: E0 machinery calibration v2: the v1 benchmark (same structure, machinery, seeds, selection) with the E0-C2 calibrated outcome model and an exposure sensitivity grid

builds_on.reused: evals.e0 generator, machinery, runners, scorer, structure, replication helpers and its committed data files (structure npz, replication npz, deny-list); v2 verifies the v1 manifest before every run

calibration.rounding: scenario values are the receipt's pooled fit rounded to 2-3 significant figures; factor_ar1 is 0 (not identified: 90% CI -0.78..0.40; owner decision 2026-10-01); label_missing_rate keeps e0-v1's 0.002 floor (the survivor panel cannot observe delisting)

selection.raw_threshold_note: v1 Stage-0 power counts raw two-sided p <= run_alpha / trials (the smallest Holm threshold)

gaussian_idio.note: v1 Stage-0 equivalent: constant-variance Gaussian idiosyncratic noise, no factors

factor_t_garch.note: market + 3 industry/style factors, GARCH(1,1) volatility clustering, Student-t(4) tails, dispersed idiosyncratic vol, loadings independent of the feature

factor_t_garch_exposed.note: factor_t_garch plus a style exposure: entity loading on factor 1 correlated 0.3 with the entity's insider-buy propensity (insider buying clusters in small/value/beaten-down names)

factor_t_garch_calibrated.note: E0-C2 calibrated outcome model (pre-2007-11-01 non-Technology prices), no style exposure

factor_t_garch_calibrated_exposed_015.note: calibrated model plus style exposure 0.15: factor-1 loading correlated 0.15 with insider-buy propensity (exposure is not identifiable from prices: a sensitivity grid)

factor_t_garch_calibrated_exposed_030.note: calibrated model plus style exposure 0.3: factor-1 loading correlated 0.3 with insider-buy propensity (exposure is not identifiable from prices: a sensitivity grid)

factor_t_garch_calibrated_exposed_045.note: calibrated model plus style exposure 0.45: factor-1 loading correlated 0.45 with insider-buy propensity (exposure is not identifiable from prices: a sensitivity grid)

full.note: v1's three scenarios are unchanged and their published e0-v1 scorecard (same machinery hash, seeds and structure) is the v1 column of the v2 report; run them with --scenarios to recompute

vs1_design_crosscheck.status: information, not a gate: VS1 v8's binding Stage-0 is the one its registered body names (E0 v1 factor_t_garch_exposed + the v1 Gaussian simulator)
vs1_design_crosscheck.rule: v8 body section 1.2: A90|fwd5 alone, one-sided positive block sign-flip p <= 0.05 (v8 e0_power)
vs1_design_crosscheck.geometry: the committed v7 Technology structure (414 A90|fwd5 dates, 202 issuers) = v8's registered 2011-10-01 screen row; the selected 2008-01-01 geometry (603 dates) is not committed here
vs1_design_crosscheck.source: analysis/panel_insider_density_v8.py DESIGN (PR #769, merge ecaa7e01; prereg body sha256 74679d00...)

replication.note: v1's replication (same panel file, deny-list and declared trials) restricted to dates < 2007-11-01: VS1 v8 / sectors-v6 make non-Technology 2008-2010 a registered window, so v2 reads none of it. v1's own replication (through 2010-12-30) is unchanged in evals/e0.
